representation.plain_text: Algorithm 1 ReAP Pipeline 1: function BUILDMEMORY(D train ) 2: R ← ∅ 3: for (t j , τ j ) ∈ D train do 4: R ← R ∪ {(t j , R(τ j ), Embed(t j ))} 5: end for 6: return R 7: end function 8: function REAPPROMPT(t i , R) 9: q ← Embed(t i ) ▷ Embed current task 10: {K 1 , ..., K k } ← Retrieve(q, R, k) 11: return Agent(t i ⊕ K 1 ⊕ • • • ⊕ K k ) 12: end function
